What we collect

We do not require accounts and do not run ads or analytics on this site. We do not collect your name or your wallet’s private keys, and we never will.

On-chain data

When you use a wallet, your address and transactions are public on the blockchain. That data is not controlled by us.

Your browser

This site stores a small setting in your browser (your cookie notice choice). You can clear it at any time.

Third-party services

The site loads fonts from Google Fonts, and links to Polygonscan and MetaMask. Those services have their own privacy policies and may see your IP address when you use them.

Emails

If you email us, we use your message and address only to reply. We do not sell or share them.

Your choices

You may ask us to delete any email correspondence with you by writing to us.
